verdict.rationale: Weave is an observability SaaS with API-key bearer auth, so the question of scoped agent credentials applies. However, the evidence only shows that API keys exist for the Service API. Nothing documents scoped, read-only, project-limited or otherwise least-privilege keys that could be issued to an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
